excerpt: PARTIAL-GENERIC-ESSENCE Being F is partially what it is to be G iff: there is some H such that for a thing to be G is for it to be both F and H (in symbols: Gx ºx Fx Ù Hx).
overview: The formula specifies how partial essence differs from full essence. Partial essence is modeled by conjunctive parthood within generalized identity, giving the paper a structured way to say that one feature is only part of what another feature is.
title: Partial Essence Formula
